anchors.title: Darwin Waterfront Precinct
anchors.description: Reclaimed harbour district with a stinger-free recreational lagoon, wave pool and waterfront dining. The Royal Flying Doctor Service Darwin Tourist Facility tells the story of the 1942 Bombing of Darwin in a hologram theatre.

anchors.title: Crocosaurus Cove — Cage of Death
anchors.description: Be lowered into the saltwater crocodile enclosure inside a clear acrylic 'Cage of Death' — face-to-face with a 5-metre apex predator. The world's only crocodile dive in the heart of a CBD.

anchors.title: George Brown Darwin Botanic Gardens
anchors.description: One of the few botanic gardens in the world with both marine and estuarine plant communities. 42 hectares of tropical flora, monsoon rainforest and a Children's Evolutionary Playground.

anchors.title: Museum & Art Gallery of the NT
anchors.description: Free entry to the Northern Territory's flagship museum. Highlights include the world's most comprehensive Cyclone Tracy exhibit and Sweetheart — the 5.1m saltwater crocodile that became Darwin's most famous animal.

anchors.title: East Point Reserve at Sunset
anchors.description: Cliff-top reserve and the closest place to the city to watch the legendary Darwin sunset over the Beagle Gulf. Bring mozzie spray and stop at the Defence of Darwin Experience on the way out.

anchors.title: Litchfield National Park Day Trip
anchors.description: 90-minute drive south of the city to safe, croc-free swimming holes at Wangi, Florence and Buley Rockhole, plus the cathedral-sized magnetic termite mounds. The most accessible national park from Darwin.

THURSDAY.title: Mindil Beach Sunset Market
THURSDAY.description: Darwin's quintessential dry-season market on the beach. 200+ stalls of South-East Asian street food, arts, crafts and live music. Thursday and Sunday from May to October, 4pm-9pm.

SATURDAY.title: Parap Village Markets
SATURDAY.description: Asian street-food market every Saturday morning in the suburb of Parap. Laksa, papaya salad, gozleme and fresh tropical fruit — go hungry.

SUNDAY.title: Mindil Beach Sunset Market
SUNDAY.description: The big Sunday session — packed crowds, more performers and the best chance to catch the sun setting over the gulf with a plate of laksa in hand. Dry season only.
